LanguageData.CK_VerticalWarehouse.label: vertical warehouse
LanguageData.CK_VerticalWarehouse.description: A 2x2 internal warehouse. Colonists can drop items into it and take them out from the inspect pane; contents are stored inside and do not occupy map cells. By default it only accepts food, herbal medicine and hay; internal temperature is adjustable and defaults to 4°C.
